basic_details.short_information: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda is engaging one Project Intern in the Department of Geography for the SERB-funded project on glacier dynamics in the Indian Himalaya Region, at a fellowship of Rs. 5,000/- per month for a maximum of 2 months. Candidates pursuing a B.Tech./B.Sc./B.A. or M.Sc./M.A. degree in Geography, Earth Sciences or allied disciplines must email the prescribed application to [email protected] by 3 December 2026. The interview is on 4 December 2026 at 11:00 AM onwards, offline or online.

content_sections.heading: CUP Project Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Ascertaining the response of glaciers dynamics post-Medieval Climate Anomaly (MCA) across the precipitation gradient in the Indian Himalaya Region (IHR) (Project No. CRG/2022/008280)
Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India
Project duration 3 Years; engagement period maximum for 2 month
Below 28 years as on date of interview

content_sections.heading: About CUP
content_sections.text: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda is a university established vide Act No. 25 (2009) of Parliament, with its address at VPO- Ghudda, Bathinda, Punjab-151401. The Project Intern post sits in a research project led by Dr. Pritam Chand, Assistant Professor, Department of Geography, as Principal Investigator. Dr. Jitendra Kumar Pattanaik, Associate Professor, Department of Geology, is the Co-Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be pursuing a B.Tech./B.Sc./B.A. or M.Sc./M.A. degree in Geography, Earth Sciences, or allied disciplines from an AICTE- or UGC-recognised university/institution. The marks required in the preceding semester are: Familiarity with GIS/Remote Sensing/Programming/DGPS/Drone Mapping. At least basic mathematical-statistical knowledge. The age limit is below 28 years as on the date of interview. Relaxation in age is permissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Intern receives a fellowship of Rs. 5,000/- per month only. The engagement period is a maximum of 2 months, within a project duration of 3 years. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUP Project Intern
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application format from the university website, www.cup.edu.in or www.cup.edu.in/other_jobs.php . Email the application to the project investigator at [email protected] by 3 December 2026. If you will attend the interview online, also email the printout of the application form and self-attested copies of all supporting documents to [email protected] . Wait for an email: only shortlisted candidates, informed through e-mail, are called for interview. For more details or clarification, contact Project Investigator Dr. Pritam Chand by email or on +91-9650966260. Application in the prescribed format. Printout of the application form (candidates appearing online for the interview). Self-attested copies of all supporting documents (candidates appearing online for the interview).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates, informed through e-mail, are called for the interview. The interview is on 4 December 2026 at 11:00 AM onwards and may be offline or online. The notice does not describe any other selection stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No canvassing in any form will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates attending online must send the application printout and self-attested supporting documents by email.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Intern posts are there at CUP?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 post of Project Intern under Advt. No. Pro- 361 (2026).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 03 December 2026, and the application goes by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CUP Project Intern?
faq.answer: The candidate must be pursuing a B.Tech./B.Sc./B.A. or M.Sc./M.A. degree in Geography, Earth Sciences or allied disciplines from an AICTE- or UGC-recognised university/institution, with 55% marks (General/OBC) or 50% (SC/ST/PwD) in the preceding semester.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must be below 28 years as on the date of interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the Project Intern?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 5,000/- per month only.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement period is a maximum of 2 months. The project itself runs for 3 years.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed format from www.cup.edu.in or www.cup.edu.in/other_jobs.php and email it to [email protected] by 03 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview and how is it held?
faq.answer: The interview is on 04 December 2026 at 11:00 AM onwards, offline or online. Only shortlisted candidates informed through e-mail are called.

faq.question: Q9. What must online interview candidates send?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing online must email the printout of the application form and self-attested copies of all supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
